tailscale.accessHelp: Allow approved connections to this current server over Tailscale HTTPS. Workers keep their own lifetime.
tailscale.confirmHelp: This exposes only the current server at the address below. Tailscale HTTPS and policy permissions are required.
tailscale.stopped: Start Tailscale outside DeliDev, then refresh.
tailscale.loggedOut: Sign in to Tailscale outside DeliDev, then refresh.
tailscale.incomplete: Tailscale returned incomplete information. Refresh to retry.
tailscale.tls: HTTPS identity could not be verified
tailscale.unsupported: DeliDev is not available at this address
tailscale.workerTitle: Register this device as a Worker
tailscale.workerHelp: The target becomes a separate outbound Worker for the selected current server. Its Local connection stays available.
tailscale.pending: Waiting for approval on the target device
tailscale.matchHelp: Compare this code on both devices before approval.
tailscale.approved: Approved. Confirm the matching code to complete.
tailscale.uncertain: The original result is unconfirmed. Check the same request before another action.
tailscale.unavailable: Unavailable. Check Tailscale HTTPS, permissions and existing Serve configuration.
tailscale.sshServer: This SSH Worker joins the selected current server.
tailscale.readFailed: Device information is unavailable. Refresh to repeat this read.
tailscale.workerScopeHelp: This controls the original approved Worker and its existing credential. Stop does not confirm native session cleanup.
